text: In my experience, beach morning glory is the ultimate sledgehammer for stopping a psychedelic trip cold and fast. By beach morning glory I mean *Ipomoea pes-caprae*, not morning glories in general, since none of the many relatives and cousins I tried worked the same way, though as far as I know nobody else sells it. People still find it growing in some places, under names like railroad vine.
reader: someone sitting with a friend whose psychedelic trip has gone bad enough that they want it over, or whose nausea won't stop, deciding how to give beach morning glory and how much
